Name: Stardew Media Keys
Author: Angebro3
Description:
This mod provides an in-game pop-up menu that provides the player with the use of media keys (previous track, pause/play, next track) in order to control media on your system, such as Spotify.

I made this mod because I hate having to tab out of Stardew to pause my music on Spotify, skip a song, etc. This allows that to be possible in game!

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
The player must use the configurable menu keybind (the period key by default) in order to bring up the pop-up menu. Once opened, there will be three buttons. From left to right, the buttons will be the previous track button, the play/pause button, and the next track button. Clicking those will control your system's media output accordingly (such as Spotify). To close the menu, you can click escape, click the x (top right), right-click, or click the keybind for the menu again.

Additionally, you can now use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] mod to open Stardew Media Keys.

Usable during cutscenes (so you can pause your music during them).

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Windows (untested on previous versions)
[*]Untested on Linux and macOS, however, as this is a simple and straightforward mod, I would be surprised if it didn't work on them
[*] Works with SMAPI 3.13.4 (untested on previous versions)
[*]Works in single player
[*]Works in solo-multiplayer (hosting a multiplayer lobby by myself) which could be indicative of if it works in actual multiplayer
[*]Untested in multiplayer, however, I would expect there to be no issues in multiplayer for this mod
[*]The pop-up menu is broken in split-screen mode as the menu does not take split-screen into account which puts the menu in a weird spot
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
You can configure this mod by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Otherwise, you can do the following:

Open the StardewMediaKeys folder in [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] and open up the config.json file. There, you can edit the configurations.
[*] ToggleKey: The keybind to click to open up the menu
This [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Button_codes]keybinds[/url] link lists out the possible values,

[*] BlueNotDefaultText: The title in the pop-up menu will be blue if this is set to true and the default text color if set to "false"
BlueNotDefaultText is so that if you have a UI alteration that makes the background of the menu blue, you can change this to false, so that the text is more readable (or you hate blue).

[*] OnlyUsableWithPhone: This disables the keybind set by ToggleKey, so that you can only open this mod via your [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url]
